title: secp256k1-ecdlp: Pollard's rho with distinguished points

claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r), input Q=[x]P on secp256k1, the Pollard's rho algorithm with distinguished points and negation map recovers x with success probability at least 0.39 using at most 2^128.5 total target-group-operation equivalents (C=1000 reference), including all preprocessing, randomness, walks, distinguished point storage/lookup, verification and amplification. Peak memory is at most 2^40 bytes. This is a classical cold attack. Heuristic: random-like walk behavior under the partition function; supported by standard analyses and small experiments. No uncharged advice.

experiments.purpose: Check Pollard's rho collision finding on a small cyclic group. Does not establish production costs.
